GameRoom.title: GameRoom
GameRoom.description: Synchronized 2-player Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe match room state.

roomCode.description: 12-character cryptographically random uppercase alphanumeric room identifier.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the match room.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

currentTurn.description: Player symbol whose turn is active.

nextGridIndex.description: Forced sub-grid index (0-8) or null for free play.

grids.description: Map of 9 sub-grids ('0'..'8'), each containing 9 cell values ('X', 'O', or null).

gridWins.description: 9 entries tracking the winner ('X', 'O', 'DRAW', or null) of each sub-grid.

winner.description: Overall match winner or DRAW, null while in progress.

lastMove.description: Most recent move coordinates { gridIndex, cellIndex }, or null before the first move.

players.description: Participant metadata for X and O including uid, display name, and connection state.

logs.description: Recent tactical move log entries for the match.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Real-time multiplayer match rooms keyed by 12-character room code.
